title: Claude adds a separate opt-in for voice-training data
friendlyTitle: Claude asks separately before using voice chats for training
summary: Claude users are seeing a separate privacy prompt asking whether Anthropic may use audio recordings and voice-chat data to improve its models. The option is reported as off by default, independent of chat and coding-session training, and can be changed or deleted through privacy settings.
friendlySummary: Claude now has a separate choice for sharing voice recordings to improve AI models. Reports say the setting starts off and can be changed later.
whyItMatters: Voice recordings can contain more personal context than typed prompts, so a separate consent control is useful. Claude voice users should check Settings > Privacy and make an explicit choice rather than assuming their text-data preference also covers audio.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Voice can contain very personal information. If you use Claude voice, check the privacy setting and choose what you are comfortable sharing.
